$comment: US GENIUS covenant: a payment stablecoin is never described as earning or yielding. ONE source for both walls (apps/web genius-stablecoin-wall.test.ts and the apps/sandbox mirror in messages.test.ts), so they cannot drift (register 5.749). Patterns may only WIDEN: a narrowing is a covenant relaxation. A pairing = an earn-word within 40 characters of a stablecoin word, case-insensitive, across line breaks (the s flag, 2026-11-11). Widened 2026-11-11 (register 5.871, founder DR-2026-11-11-market-cleanup-decisions 3c): return|retorno|rentab and the pt-BR/es verbs ganhar/ganar, which the pt-BR/es copy used where English says earn. Second widening 2026-11-11 (W-B review): retorn (retorna/retornar), the Spanish rinde/rindió, interest/juros/interés/Zins/APY, and the stablecoin names USDS, USDT, DAI, PYUSD, USD Coin, stable coin. Third widening 2026-11-12 (W-B/W-C audit): a stated yearly rate ('5% a year', '5 % ao ano', '5 % al año', '5 % anual', '5 % pro Jahr', '5 % p.a.') counts as an earn claim beside a stablecoin word, plus remuner…, lucro, gains, Gewinn, Ertrag, reward/recompens…, 'pays 4%'/'paga 4%', genera (a bare percentage or 'pays' alone would flag the fee rows: 'a diBoaS user pays you in digital dollars … 0.48%'; strings shown TOGETHER also count a bare percentage, GENIUS-COMBO-1); moeda estável, moneda estable, sDAI, USDe, EURC. Both walls normalise look-alike spaces and hyphens before testing.
